title: Lead the homepage with the economics framing
problem: Capability is clearer than commercial consequence.
why_it_matters: The audience decides on consequence, not on stack.
strategic_rationale: The territory is unoccupied across the comparison set.
recommended_change: Improve messaging across the site and build trust with the audience.
expected_outcome: A reader can state what the work is worth within one screen.

measurement.hypothesis: Outcome-led framing raises qualified enquiry rate.
measurement.target: Establish a baseline, then improve on it
measurement.validation_method: Compare enquiry quality over eight weeks.
measurement.falsifier: No change in qualified enquiry rate after eight weeks of comparable traffic.
